``` {r cif development}

#this code creates Figure 2

admin_censor_date = as.Date("2025-06-30")

init_status_1a = fortable1 %>% 
  filter(initial_status == "1A") %>%
  mutate(
    competing_outcome = case_when(
      REM_CD %in% c(8, 13) ~ 1,
      !is.na(TX_DATE) & REM_CD == 4 ~ 2,
      REM_CD == 12 ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 0),
    competing_outcome_date = case_when(
      competing_outcome != 0 ~ END_DATE,
      competing_outcome == 0 & !is.na(REM_CD) ~ END_DATE,
      TRUE ~ admin_censor_date),
    competing_outcome = as.factor(competing_outcome),
    competing_time = as.numeric(competing_outcome_date - INIT_DATE)) %>%
  mutate(
    death = ifelse(REM_CD %in% c(8, 13), 1, 0),
    end_date = case_when(
      death == 1 ~ END_DATE,
      death == 0 & !is.na(REM_CD) ~ END_DATE,
      TRUE ~ admin_censor_date),
    time = as.numeric(end_date - INIT_DATE),
    status_1a_just_labels = case_when(
      STATUS_JUST == "Status 1A: Exception" ~ "Exception",
      STATUS_JUST == "Status 1A: Congenital Heart Disease" ~ "Congenital Heart Disease with Inotropes",
      STATUS_JUST == "Status 1A: Ductal-Dependent Circulation" ~ "Ductal-Dependent Circulation",
      STATUS_JUST == "Status 1A: MCS/IABP" ~ "MCS/IABP",
      STATUS_JUST == "Status 1A: Mechanical Ventilation" ~ "Mechanical Ventilation"),
    status_1a_just_labels = factor(status_1a_just_labels, c("Exception", "Congenital Heart Disease with Inotropes", "Ductal-Dependent Circulation", "MCS/IABP", "Mechanical Ventilation")))



init_status_1b = fortable1 %>% 
  filter(initial_status == "1B") %>%
  mutate(
    competing_outcome = case_when(
      REM_CD %in% c(8, 13) ~ 1,
      !is.na(TX_DATE) & REM_CD == 4 ~ 2,
      REM_CD == 12 ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 0),
    competing_outcome_date = case_when(
      competing_outcome != 0 ~ END_DATE,
      competing_outcome == 0 & !is.na(REM_CD) ~ END_DATE,
      TRUE ~ admin_censor_date),
    competing_outcome = as.factor(competing_outcome),
    competing_time = as.numeric(competing_outcome_date - INIT_DATE)) %>%
  mutate(
    death = ifelse(REM_CD %in% c(8, 13), 1, 0),
    end_date = case_when(
      death == 1 ~ END_DATE,
      death == 0 & !is.na(REM_CD) ~ END_DATE,
      TRUE ~ admin_censor_date),
    time = as.numeric(end_date - INIT_DATE),
    status_1b_just_labels = case_when(
      STATUS_JUST == "Status 1B: Exception" ~ "Exception",
      STATUS_JUST == "Status 1B: Standard 1B Listing" ~ "Standard Listing"),
    status_1b_just_labels = factor(status_1b_just_labels, c("Exception", "Standard Listing")))
```

``` {r figure 1}

fortable1 = fortable1 %>%
  mutate(
    competing_outcome = case_when(
      REM_CD %in% c(8, 13) ~ 1,
      !is.na(TX_DATE) & REM_CD == 4 ~ 2,
      REM_CD == 12 ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 0),
    competing_outcome_date = case_when(
      competing_outcome != 0 ~ END_DATE,
      competing_outcome == 0 & !is.na(REM_CD) ~ END_DATE,
      TRUE ~ admin_censor_date),
    competing_time = as.numeric(competing_outcome_date - INIT_DATE))

justtransplants = fortable1 %>% filter(competing_outcome == 2) 
median(justtransplants$competing_time)

just1a = fortable1 %>% filter(initial_status == "1A")
summary(just1a$competing_time)

just1b = fortable1 %>% filter(initial_status == "1B")
summary(just1b$competing_time)

just2 = fortable1 %>% filter(initial_status == "2")
summary(just2$competing_time)

options("ggsurvfit.switch-color-linetype" = TRUE)

cif_fit = cuminc(Surv(competing_time, as.factor(competing_outcome)) ~ 1, data = fortable1)

cif_fit = cif_fit %>%
  ggcuminc(outcome = c("1", "2", "3")) +
  add_confidence_interval() +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 360)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300, 360)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::percent, 
    expand = c(0.01, 0)
  ) +
  add_risktable(times = seq(0, 360, 60), size = 6,
                theme = theme_risktable_default(axis.text.y.size = 18)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 360), breaks = seq(0, 360, 60)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Outcome",
                     values = c("1" = "#374e55", "2" = "#df8f44", "3" = "#00a1d5"),
                     labels = c("Death/Clinical Deterioration", "Transplant", "Removal for Clinical Recovery")) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Outcome",
                    values = c("1" = "#374e55", "2" = "#df8f44", "3" = "#00a1d5"),
                    labels = c("Death/Clinical Deterioration", "Transplant", "Removal for Clinical Recovery")) +
  labs(x = "Days after Initial Listing", y = "Cumulative Incidence") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size = 18))

# Fit the cumulative incidence model
cif_model <- cuminc(Surv(competing_time, as.factor(competing_outcome)) ~ 1, 
                    data = fortable1)

# Extract cumulative incidence at 365 days (or closest timepoint)
cif_365 <- cif_model %>%
  tidy() %>%
  filter(time <= 365) %>%
  group_by(outcome) %>%
  slice_max(time, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(outcome, time, estimate, conf.low, conf.high)

print(cif_365)

# Format as table
cif_365 %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_label = case_when(
      outcome == "1" ~ "Death/Clinical Deterioration",
      outcome == "2" ~ "Transplant",
      outcome == "3" ~ "Removal for Clinical Recovery"
    ),
    `Cumulative Incidence (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%% - %.1f%%)", 
                                               estimate*100, conf.low*100, conf.high*100)
  ) %>%
  select(Outcome = outcome_label, `Days` = time, `Cumulative Incidence (95% CI)`)

library(tidycmprsk)
library(gtsummary)

# Fine-Gray regression for each outcome
# Outcome 1: Death/Clinical Deterioration
crr_outcome1 <- crr(
  Surv(competing_time, as.factor(competing_outcome)) ~ initial_status, 
  data = fortable1,
  failcode = "1"  # The outcome of interest
)

# Outcome 2: Transplant
crr_outcome2 <- crr(
  Surv(competing_time, as.factor(competing_outcome)) ~ initial_status, 
  data = fortable1,
  failcode = "2"
)

# Outcome 3: Removal for Clinical Recovery
crr_outcome3 <- crr(
  Surv(competing_time, as.factor(competing_outcome)) ~ initial_status, 
  data = fortable1,
  failcode = "3"
)

# View results with tbl_regression
tbl_regression(crr_outcome1, exponentiate = TRUE)
tbl_regression(crr_outcome2, exponentiate = TRUE)
tbl_regression(crr_outcome3, exponentiate = TRUE)

# Or get summary statistics
summary(crr_outcome1)
summary(crr_outcome2)
summary(crr_outcome3)


p1 <- tidy(crr_outcome1)$p.value[1]
p2 <- tidy(crr_outcome2)$p.value[1]
p3 <- tidy(crr_outcome3)$p.value[1]

# Format p-values
p1_text <- ifelse(p1 < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p1))
p2_text <- ifelse(p2 < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p2))
p3_text <- ifelse(p3 < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p3))

# Add to plot
cif_fit1 +
  annotate("text", x = 100, y = 0.95, 
           label = paste0("Death/Deterioration: ", p1_text),
           size = 5, hjust = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = 100, y = 0.90, 
           label = paste0("Transplant: ", p2_text),
           size = 5, hjust = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = 100, y = 0.85, 
           label = paste0("Clinical Recovery: ", p3_text),
           size = 5, hjust = 1)
```

``` {r create fig 2}

library(tidyverse)
library(survival)
library(cmprsk)
library(tidycmprsk)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(ggsci)
library(scales)
# Your dataset is ready - init_status_1a

# Verify the competing outcome coding
table(init_status_1a$competing_outcome, useNA = "always")
# 0 = censored, 1 = death/deterioration, 2 = transplant, 3 = recovery

# Verify STATUS_JUST labels
table(init_status_1a$status_1a_just_labels, useNA = "always")

# Remove any missing STATUS_JUST
init_status_1a_clean <- init_status_1a %>%
  filter(!is.na(status_1a_just_labels))

# ============================================================================
# METHOD 1: Using tidycmprsk (Recommended - easier and cleaner)
# ============================================================================

# Create cumulative incidence object
cuminc_obj <- cuminc(
  Surv(competing_time, competing_outcome) ~ status_1a_just_labels,
  data = init_status_1a_clean
)

# Test for differences between groups
# This tests if cumulative incidence curves differ by STATUS_JUST
# for outcome = 1 (death/deterioration)
print(cuminc_obj)

# Extract p-value for death/deterioration outcome
cif_direct <- cmprsk::cuminc(
  ftime = init_status_1a_clean$competing_time,
  fstatus = init_status_1a_clean$competing_outcome,
  group = init_status_1a_clean$status_1a_just_labels,
  cencode = 0
)

# Print test results
print("\n=== Gray's Test Results ===")
print(cif_direct$Tests)

# Extract p-value for outcome 1 (death/deterioration)
# Row 1 = outcome 1, Column 2 = p-value
pval_death <- cif_direct$Tests[1, 2]
cat("\nP-value for death/deterioration:", pval_death, "\n")

# Format p-value for plot
pval_text <- if_else(pval_death < 0.001, 
                     "Gray's test p < 0.001",
                     sprintf("Gray's test p = %.3f", pval_death))

# ============================================================================
# Cumulative Incidence Analysis for Status 1A by Indication
# ============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(survival)
library(cmprsk)
library(tidycmprsk)
library(ggsurvfit)

# ============================================================================
# Get p-value using cmprsk directly
# ============================================================================

cif_direct <- cmprsk::cuminc(
  ftime = init_status_1a_clean$competing_time,
  fstatus = init_status_1a_clean$competing_outcome,
  group = init_status_1a_clean$status_1a_just_labels,
  cencode = 0
)

# Extract p-value for outcome 1 (death/deterioration)
pval_death <- cif_direct$Tests[1, 2]
cat("P-value for death/deterioration:", pval_death, "\n")

# Format p-value for plot
pval_text <- if_else(pval_death < 0.001, 
                     "Gray's test p < 0.001",
                     sprintf("Gray's test p = %.3f", pval_death))

# ============================================================================
# Create tidycmprsk object for plotting
# ============================================================================

cuminc_obj <- cuminc(
  Surv(competing_time, competing_outcome) ~ status_1a_just_labels,
  data = init_status_1a_clean
)

fig <- cuminc_obj %>%
  ggcuminc(outcome = "1", linewidth = 1.2) +
  add_confidence_interval() +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Exception" = "#374e55",
      "Congenital Heart Disease with Inotropes" = "#79af97",
      "Ductal-Dependent Circulation" = "#b24745",
      "MCS/IABP" = "#00a1d5",
      "Mechanical Ventilation" = "#df8f44"
    ),
    name = NULL  # Remove legend title
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Exception" = "#374e55",
      "Congenital Heart Disease with Inotropes" = "#79af97",
      "Ductal-Dependent Circulation" = "#b24745",
      "MCS/IABP" = "#00a1d5",
      "Mechanical Ventilation" = "#df8f44"
    ),
    name = NULL  # Remove legend title
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 0.4),
    labels = scales::percent, 
    expand = c(0.01, 0)
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 365),
    breaks = seq(0, 365, 60),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Days after Initial Listing",
    y = "Cumulative Incidence of Death\nor Clinical Deterioration",
    title = ""
  ) +
  
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
    fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
    linetype = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE, override.aes = list(fill = NA))
  ) +
  
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 90, y = 0.35,
    label = pval_text,
    size = 4,
    hjust = 1
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),  # Use element_blank() not element_text("")
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3)
  ) +
  
  add_risktable(
    times = seq(0, 360, 60),
    size = 5,
    theme = theme_risktable_default(
      axis.text.y.size = 14,
      plot.title.size = 14
    )
  )

print(fig)


# Create cuminc object (if not already created)
cuminc_obj <- cuminc(
  Surv(competing_time, competing_outcome) ~ status_1a_just_labels,
  data = init_status_1a_clean
)


ci_all_outcomes <- cuminc_obj %>%
  tidy() %>%
  filter(time <= 365) %>%
  group_by(strata, outcome) %>%
  slice_max(time, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_label = case_when(
      outcome == "1" ~ "Death/Deterioration",
      outcome == "2" ~ "Transplant",
      outcome == "3" ~ "Recovery",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    ci_percent = estimate * 100,
    ci_formatted = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%%, %.1f%%)", 
                           estimate * 100, 
                           conf.low * 100, 
                           conf.high * 100)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(strata, outcome, outcome_label, time, 
         ci_percent, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, ci_formatted)

print("\n=== Cumulative Incidence at 365 Days - All Outcomes ===")
print(ci_all_outcomes)

```
